newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom pays 21bln rph for cellular stake.
newsitem.headline: Telkom pays 21bln rph for cellular stake.

text.p: Indonesia's telecommunication giant PT Telkom said on Friday it would pay 21 billion rupiah in cash for its 35 percent equity participation in cellular phone operator PT Komselindo.

The company said in the statement it had signed an agreement on Thursday with PT Elektrindo Nusantara to set up a joint-venture PT Komselindo, with Telkom and Elektrindo taking stakes of 35 percent and 65 percent respectively.
"The capital ...will be used to expand PT Komselindo's business," the statement said.
"With such participation, PT Telkom expects to get a dividend and to benefit from the increased interconnection revenue in line wiht the increased celluar business in Indonesia as well," it said.
The statement said that since 1990 PT Telkom and PT Elektrindo Nusantara have had a revenue sharing arrangement to operate AMPS cellular telephones in Jakarta and the West Java area.
